title: chore: update app metrics 2026-10-03
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden keeps count
gist.blurb: The daily app tally gets another entry. Even a garden of apps needs someone to count the sprouts.
gist.summary: The automated October 3, 2026 update refreshes app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json.
gist.impact: App-management records gain a current snapshot for tracking request and repository activity; this does not change the user-facing app experience.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the metrics update as a dated ledger beside a garden of small app-shaped code-plants. Polli, wearing tiny accountant glasses, checks the tally while the Monitor Robot holds the ledger; keep the mood cozy rather than presenting the data as a new user-facing feature.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, a chunky CRT-headed Monitor Robot holds a little ledger dated 'OCT 3' beside app-shaped code-plants and a prominently lime green (#ecf874) tally board.
